pages.title: New SharePoint experience (Preview)
pages.description: This article describes the new SharePoint experience and its features.
pages.about: Describes the new SharePoint experience — a redesigned interface for SharePoint Online that replaces the classic navigation with a modernized home page, app bar, and site experience. Covers feature details, rollout timeline, and admin controls.
changes: Public Preview ended: The notice that "Public Preview concluded on May 4" and rollout via standard release has been removed — the feature is now in general availability.
Heading renamed: "Enable the new SharePoint experience" → "New SharePoint Experience" — reflecting it is no longer opt-in.
Terminology update: "SharePoint start page" changed to "SharePoint home page."
Preview toggle removed: The mention of the app bar toggle that allowed users to switch back to the previous experience (available only during preview) has been removed.

pages.title: Get sites and files shared via special SharePoint groups
pages.description: In this article, you learn how to get item-level permission details for content shared with 'Everyone except external users' (EEEU) and 'Everyone'.
pages.about: Documents a new Data Access Governance snapshot report in SharePoint Advanced Management. This report provides exact item-level permission details for every item where the special SharePoint groups "Everyone except external users" (EEEU) or "Everyone" are recipients — helping admins identify and remediate oversharing risks across their tenant.
changes: New page: This is a newly published documentation page — no previous version existed.
Key content: Explains what the EEEU/Everyone permissions report shows, when to use it, how to generate it via the SharePoint admin center or PowerShell, and how to download and interpret the results.
Use case: Enables admins to find exactly where oversharing happens and fix it through scripting rather than relying on individual site owners.
